C1374.title: Hyperliquid Wallet Private Key Leak Leads to $21 Million Theft
C1374.summary: The Hyperliquid platform suffered a wallet attack resulting in a $21 million loss. Unlike smart contract exploits or exchange breaches, this incident stemmed directly from a private key leak, where the attacker gained direct access to wallet login credentials and transferred the assets.

references.title: $21 Million Vanishes After Hyperliquid Wallet Hack
